interpretation.data_split: All four windows are historical development data; retrospective, not unseen validation

interpretation.comparison: Same cases, fleet, rules, SIPP and linear physical objective; simple/wide changes a budget bundle
interpretation.adoption: No automatic selection or default change from these development results
